hook: *Three* sanitation workers die inside a septic tank in Bachupally
hook_b: *Three* sanitation workers die inside a septic tank in Bachupally
tldr: Three workers from septic tank cleaning agency HR Invests entered an underground tank at a Bachupally apartment complex on Tuesday and did not come out.

beats.what: Bachupally police registered a case and are probing toxic gas build-up and asphyxiation.
beats.why: Closed septic tanks can collect toxic gases; police are examining the safety arrangements in place.
beats.care: Apartment associations hire such agencies routinely; who checks the safety gear is the open question.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Police are examining whether the workers had adequate protective equipment before being sent into the confined space.

cards.q: Who should be held responsible when workers die cleaning a septic tank?

qs: Should apartment complexes be required to use machines instead of people for tank cleaning?
Who verifies a cleaning agency's safety gear before work starts?

facts.t: The three workers who died were aged *24, 25 and 25*.

steps.e: Three workers enter an underground septic tank
They do not come out; residents alert police
Bachupally police retrieve bodies, register case
Probe into toxic gas and safety gear

viz.verdict: Three young workers lost; safety arrangements under investigation

watch: What the probe finds on gas levels and protective equipment, and whether the agency faces charges.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad: Three sanitation workers die in septic tank

fact: *Three* young sanitation workers died cleaning an apartment septic tank in Bachupally
twist: The workers were 24, 25 and 25, and police are now checking whether they were given any protective gear before entering.
